segments.he: ״מֵת״, ״הֲרַגְתִּיו״, ״הֲרַגְנוּהוּ״ — לֹא יִשָּׂא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ. הוּא נִיהוּ דְּלֹא יִשָּׂא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ, הָא לְאַחֵר תִּנָּשֵׂא.
segments.en: The mishna stated that if the witness said with regard to the husband that «he died,» or: «I killed him,» or: «We killed him,» then «he may not marry» the «wife» of the deceased. The Gemara infers that «he,» the witness «himself, may not marry» the «wife; this» implies that «to another she may be married» on the basis of his testimony.
